purpose.zh: 拉开胯前面，久坐发紧时松一松
purpose.en: Stretches the front of your hip to ease tightness from sitting.

text.zh: 夹紧屁股，胯慢慢往前推
text.en: Squeeze your butt and ease your hips forward

text.zh: 前后分腿站，后脚踮起，一手扶椅背。
text.en: Split stance, back heel up, one hand on the chair.

text.zh: 后脚跟抬起，后腿伸长，胯前面一路被拉开。
text.en: Back heel up, back leg long, feel the front of that hip open.

text.zh: 呼气时屁股再夹紧一点，胯往前送一点点就够。
text.en: Each breath out, squeeze your butt a little harder and ease your hips forward.

commonErrors.zh: 胯没往前，靠挺肚子往后仰
commonErrors.en: Pushing your belly out and leaning back instead of moving your hips.
Front knee shooting way past your toes.

cautions.zh: 腰疼就推少点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back hurts, don't push as far. Stop if it still hurts.
